title: Among customers who belong to either the LAM or KAM segment and have consum
question: Among customers who belong to either the LAM or KAM segment and have consumption records in 2013, identify the one with the highest total consumption in 2013. For this customer, compute the average price per item (total price divided by total amount) across all their transactions, and return their customer ID, average price per item, and segment.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_002 IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(ym.XCL_021) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
  CAST(SUM(t.XCL_018) AS REAL) / SUM(t.XCL_017) AS average_price_per_item,
  c.XCL_002 AS segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
JOIN eligible e ON c.XCL_001 = e.customer_id
GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_002 IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(ym.XCL_021) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
  CAST(SUM(t.XCL_018) AS REAL) / SUM(t.XCL_017) AS average_price_per_item,
  c.XCL_002 AS segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
JOIN eligible e ON c.XCL_001 = e.customer_id
GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002;

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_002 IN ('LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTRING(ym.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
    ORDER BY SUM(ym.XCL_021) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
  CAST(SUM(t.XCL_018) AS REAL) / SUM(t.XCL_017) AS average_price_per_item,
  c.XCL_002 AS segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
JOIN eligible e ON c.XCL_001 = e.customer_id
GROUP BY c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001",
       SUM(T3."XCL_018") / SUM(T3."XCL_017") AS avg_price_per_item,
       T1."XCL_002"
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" IN ('LAM','KAM') AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020",1,4) = '2013'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
LIMIT 1;
